# Pathway Language Solutions

> Online French school that prepares Latin Americans for TEF Canada, TCF Canada and NCLC 7 — the linguistic threshold for Express Entry immigration to Canada.

Pathway offers private live French lessons from native-speaking teachers, with personalized study plans from A1 to B2. Students are primarily Spanish-speaking professionals from Peru, Colombia, Chile, Mexico, Paraguay, Bolivia and Argentina.

## Key pages

- [Home (Spanish)](https://pathway-languages.com/): Main page, programs, plans and FAQ
- [TEF Canada preparation](https://pathway-languages.com/preparacion-tef-canada.html): Guide to TEF Canada exam preparation in Spanish
- [NCLC 7 explained](https://pathway-languages.com/nclc-7.html): What NCLC 7 means for Express Entry, without migration promises
- [CRS calculator](https://pathway-languages.com/calculador.html): Estimate your Comprehensive Ranking System score in Spanish
- [Placement test](https://pathway-languages.com/test-placement.html): Free progressive French placement test
- [Enrollment](https://pathway-languages.com/inscription.html): Choose your rhythm and request enrollment

## Programs

- A1 program: Complete beginners → French foundations (approx. 6 months at 2h/week)
- A2 program: Elementary → Everyday communication (approx. 6 months at 2h/week)
- B1 program: Intermediate → TEF/TCF preparation begins (approx. 6 months at 2h/week)
- B2 program: Upper intermediate → NCLC 7 target and exam readiness

## Pricing

Monthly subscription, no commitment. Plans: Esencial (2h/week), Acelerado (4h/week), Intensivo (6h/week). Prices in CAD with equivalents shown in local currencies (PEN, COP, CLP, MXN, ARS, BOB).
